scenario.name: Test: gitlist_040
scenario.author: Thomas Shaw
scenario.description: Single-VM test scenario for the gitlist_040 vulnerability module on patched PHP 7.4 (Debian 10 Buster), used to exercise its secgen_test via the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent testing pipeline. No attacker VM: the msf tier-3 exploit is exercised in a separate scenario.
